1.guide: The platinum, Vice Got a Price!, needs no job of its own: it unlocks the second the other 54 trophies are all yours. Treat the rest of this guide as the route there — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, and 100% to finish.
steps: Play the whole story — Chapters 1-4 plus the finale — and pick up both partner trophies while the story keeps you paired.
Clear strangers, activities, collectibles and the counting grinds in roadmap order.
Wrap up 100% completion; the platinum pops on its own.
1.first_step: Begin a new game and finish the opening mission — think marathon, not sprint, for this one.
1.watch_out: The partner trophies are the trap: their window is the story, and it may not reopen if you pass it by.

48.guide: Actions Speak Louder is the choices trophy: 'Choices made (for better or worse).' The story will ask you to decide; the parenthetical warns a decision can cut the other way, so save before big choices if the game allows it.
steps: Play until a choice point appears.
Save first if manual saves exist.
Decide and live with it — the trophy lands on the deciding.
48.first_step: The first time the story asks you to choose, save first.
48.watch_out: A choice may not be redoable without a replay — the save before it is your only safety net.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (via Exophase trophy list)

49.guide: Bad Luck, I Guess is the second-try trophy: 'Second time's the charm.' Fail an activity once, then succeed at the same one on the next attempt — retryable by nature.
steps: Try an activity and let the first attempt fail.
Try the same activity again straight away.
Succeed on the second attempt for the pop.
49.first_step: Pick a short activity you can retry quickly, like a race or arcade game.
49.watch_out: The success has to be the very next attempt at the same activity — do not do something else in between.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (via Exophase trophy list)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list

50.guide: The Truth Is Out There is the mystery entry: 'What the hell just happened?' No trigger is invented here — it reads like a strange event or easter egg. Explore odd corners of Leonida and write down where you were when something weird happens.
steps: Explore remote spots, strange landmarks and late-night places.
Watch for an event that breaks the ordinary pattern.
When it happens, write the place in the app.
50.first_step: Explore a remote or strange landmark late at night.
50.watch_out: This one may be a random event — do not grind one spot expecting it on a schedule.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (via Exophase trophy list)

51.target: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by
51.guide: Ten Pin is a melee drive-by: bowl people over with a melee swing from a moving vehicle. Find a crowded pavement, drive past slowly, swing — repeat until it pops.
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon.
Find a group on a pavement.
Drive past slowly and swing from the vehicle until they go down like pins.
51.first_step: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon, then find a crowded pavement.
51.watch_out: The swing has to come from a moving vehicle — on foot, it is not a drive-by.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (via Exophase trophy list)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list

52.guide: Dime on the Dollar asks for $250,000 earned laundering Marked Bills through contacts. Bills come from robberies; the total is cumulative, so keep the rob-and-launder cycle going.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through contacts.
Repeat the cycle until laundered earnings reach $250,000.
52.first_step: After your first robbery, find a contact who launders Marked Bills.
52.watch_out: Only laundered earnings count — unlaundered bills sitting in your pocket are not progress.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (via Exophase trophy list)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list

53.guide: Treat Yo Self counts $100,000 spent across all shops. Everything you buy adds up, so play normally, check the stats total, and spend the surplus in phase 4.
steps: Buy what you need as you go — every purchase counts.
Check the total spent on the stats screen.
Spend surplus cash across shops in phase 4 until $100,000.
53.first_step: Just play normally — every purchase from the start already counts.
53.watch_out: Check the stats total before a spending spree; you may already be closer than you think.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (via Exophase trophy list)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list

54.guide: Little Boxes asks for every garage property purchased. They appear as you progress and cost money, so save up and buy each garage when it shows up instead of leaving them all for the end.
steps: Save money for property as you play.
Buy each garage as it becomes available.
Check the property list for stragglers; the pop comes with the last garage.
54.first_step: Buy the first garage property as soon as one is offered.
54.watch_out: Garages appear as you progress — a garage you never visited cannot be bought at the end.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (via Exophase trophy list)

55.target: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app
55.guide: On the Spot asks for 10 vehicles registered to the Scooter Bros app — ten different vehicles, not one ten times. Find or own a new one, open the app, register it, repeat.
steps: Find or own a vehicle you have not registered.
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it.
Repeat with nine more different vehicles for the tenth-registration pop.
55.first_step: Open the Scooter Bros app with a vehicle you have not registered yet.
55.watch_out: Ten different vehicles — registering the same one ten times adds nothing.
sources: Official trophy description — PlayStation (via Exophase trophy list)
